blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines—Victoria Bossong made an impressive Asian Games debut for the Philippines, advancing to the women’s 800-meter final with the fastest time of the heats on Monday. Bossong won Heat 2 in 2 minutes, 2.34 seconds at Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium, edging China’s Li Chunhui, who clocked 2:02.35. The 23-year-old Filipino-American’s mark was the fastest across the two heats, putting her through to Tuesday’s medal race as the top qualifier.
